questions.question: A product was marked for sale with a label price, which is at 20% discount on the printed price. At the time of sale, the shopkeeper gave an additional 10% discount on the label price. If a customer bought the product at Rs. 468, then what is the printed price of the product?
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

Let the printed price of the product be ‘x’,

After giving 20% discount on the printed price,

The product price will be 0.8x.

The shopkeeper gave an additional 10 % discount on 0.8x.

Hence, the product price will become 0.72x.

A customer bought the product at Rs. 468

∴ 0.72x = 468

∴ x = 650

Hence, printed price of the given product is Rs. 650.

questions.question: ‘Wheat’ is related to ‘Bread’ in the same way as ‘Sugarcane’ is related to ‘_______’.
questions.solution:

Hence, “jaggery” is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

72 : 14

7 × 2 = 14

And,

96 : 54

Similarly,

87 : ?

Hence, “56” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the number set shares the same relationship as that shared by given number set.

(17, 24, 45)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

**(First number + 7) = Second number, (Second number + 21) = Third number**

(17, 24, 45) → 17 + 7 = 24, 24 + 21 = 45

Similarly,

**Option 1 → (12, 19, 40) → 12 + 7 = 19, 19 + 21 = 40**

Option 2 → (15, 20, 43) → 15 + 5 = 20, 20 + 23 = 43

Option 3 → (18, 23, 46) → 18 + 5 = 23, 23 + 23 = 46

Option 4 → (19, 26, 34) → 19 + 7 = 26, 26 + 8 = 34

‘(12, 19, 40)’ shares the same relationship as that shared by given number set.

Hence, “(12, 19, 40)” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Arrange the following words in a logical and meaningful order (according to population).

1. Andhra Pradesh

2. Madhya Pradesh

3. Arunachal Pradesh

4. Uttar Pradesh

5. Himachal Pradesh
questions.solution:
Arranging the states according to the population,

Uttar Pradesh has the highest population.

Uttar Pradesh is followed by Madhya Pradesh.

Madhya Pradesh is followed by Andhra Pradesh.

Andhra Pradesh is followed by Himachal Pradesh.

Himachal Pradesh is followed by Arunachal Pradesh.

The correct logical order is,

Uttar Pradesh (4) → Madhya Pradesh (2) → Andhra Pradesh (1) → Himachal Pradesh (5) → Arunachal Pradesh (3)

Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

All singers are dancers.

No dancer is a plumber.

**Conclusions:**

I. No plumber is a singer.

II. Some singers are plumbers.

III. Some dancers are singers.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Vann diagram is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb7073136624918747b26e42454f70b0d986516f1de8a385ea69c736be03ee94.png] 

**Conclusions:**

1: No plumber is a singer → True, as all singers are dancers, no dancer is a plumber.

2: Some singers are plumbers → False, as all singers are dancers, no dancer is a plumber.

3: Some dancers are singers → True, as all singers are dancers

Hence, only conclusion 1 and 3 follow.

questions.question:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Dentist : Doctor
questions.solution:
Dentist is a doctor who is qualified to treat diseases and other conditions that affect the teeth and gums.

Similarly,

Option 1 → Chemistry: Science → Chemistry is the branch of science concerned with the substances of which matter is composed.

Option 2 → Line: Circle → Line is a long narrow mark and circle is a geometric figure.

Option 3 → Biology: Astrology → Biology is the study of living organisms and Astrology is the study of celestial bodies.

Option 4 → Algebra: Geometry → Algebra is the part of mathematics in which letters and other general symbols are used to represent numbers and quantities in formulae and equations and Geometry is a branch in mathematics.

‘Chemistry: Science’ share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Hence, “chemistry: science” is the correct answer.
